purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility, insurance coverage, contract status or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: v29 correctly blocked automatic Afa coverage for self-employed users, but its learned next action could still overcorrect toward private/business insurance and miss that current Afa/Fora guidance allows TFA coverage for a self-employed owner through an actual Fora insurance or ground agreement.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep the statutory Forsakringskassan work-injury dental route separate, never infer TFA from actor label or company registration, never exclude TFA solely because the person is self-employed, and use the existence of a current Fora insurance/ground agreement as a minimum information-gain fact before presenting TFA as an actionable separate route.
